claim_boundary: C013 distinguishes strict formulation failures from unresolved mathematical barriers. A decisive DESTROYED attack may support a REJECTED graveyard status when the exact statement is circular or underspecified rather than mathematically false.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the lift can decide SAT before emitting a trivial low-treewidth formula
attacks.method: Construct the solve-and-encode transformer conditional on P=NP and observe that H001 adds no independent mechanism or restriction beyond the target theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the submodular lift can hide the SAT answer in its output
attacks.method: Conditional on a SAT decider, emit a one-variable submodular function with minimum zero exactly for YES instances; the stated formulation isolates no independent submodular mechanism.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the totally-unimodular system can encode only the already-computed answer
attacks.method: Conditional on a SAT decider, emit either a feasible or infeasible constant-size TU system; the statement is target-equivalent and mechanism-free.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the moment instance can be chosen after solving SAT
attacks.method: Conditional on a SAT decider, emit a constant-size feasible or infeasible degree-two system; constant-level language does not prevent solve-and-encode.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: an interface symbol can denote an uncharged globally hard Boolean function
attacks.method: The exact syntax, original-variable support, node semantics, and composition restrictions are absent; therefore node count and boundary-symbol count do not define a falsifiable resource bound.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the compiler may solve SAT and emit one of two constant graphs with a certified theta gap
attacks.method: Conditional on P=NP, choose a fixed SAT graph with alpha equal to target or a fixed UNSAT graph with theta below target after computing the answer; H070 does not restrict this channel.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: polynomially many bounded-radius rewrites can simulate a global Turing computation
attacks.method: Trace a cellular-automaton style space-time simulation through local certified updates; locality without a decreasing invariant does not exclude solve-and-encode.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: pure parity lower bounds disappear under the compiler's own Gaussian elimination
attacks.method: Require one explicit mixed family robust under affine elimination and restrictions; no such family is presently proved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact checking may coexist with exponentially long or irrationally conditioned witnesses
attacks.method: Separate verification from existence and inherit only the margin-conditioned reconstruction route H097.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: rational Gram square roots need not exist for rational PSD matrices
attacks.method: Use the rational PSD matrix [2] as the simplest obstruction to a one-row rational Gram square root and retain H092 LDL certificates as the complete replacement.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H011 would refute the lower-bound side
attacks.method: Search for an unconditional transfer from polynomial boundedness or current EF techniques; the required theorem is not known.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: an explicit EF lower bound would refute polynomial boundedness
attacks.method: Audit current proof-complexity frontiers; no unconditional full EF lower bound is available.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H014 would refute a full IPS lower bound
attacks.method: Restricted IPS lower bounds do not transfer to unrestricted full IPS, and no universal polynomial upper bound is known.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H007 would refute polynomial boundedness of full IPS
attacks.method: Current lower bounds remain fragment-specific; full algebraic-circuit lower bounds are the barrier.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H013 would refute TC0-Frege lower bounds
attacks.method: No unconditional polynomial boundedness or superpolynomial lower bound is known for full dag-like TC0-Frege.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: H012 would refute polynomial boundedness
attacks.method: Known restricted and conditional results do not decide proof existence in full TC0-Frege.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a Stabbing-Planes/CP separation would refute simulation
attacks.method: Known simulations cover restricted coefficient regimes and do not settle unrestricted bit-sensitive proofs.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a polynomial unrestricted simulation would refute separation
attacks.method: No exact unrestricted simulation with coefficient accounting was found.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: polynomial boundedness of recursive extension-PC would refute the lower bound
attacks.method: Existing extension-PC lower bounds do not cover the exact recursive global-support GF(2) model.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a recursive extension-PC lower bound would refute polynomial boundedness
attacks.method: No unconditional lower bound for the exact model was located; direct-PC degree bounds are insufficient.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: one of the two formulas may have the wrong SAT label
attacks.method: Recompute exact independence numbers of both conflict graphs and obtain 8 and 7 against common target 8.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the orbit matrix may violate trace, edge zeros, objective, or PSD
attacks.method: Construct all 12 pair orbits exactly and verify the rational matrix using an exact LDL certificate.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: edge multipliers or the factor of two may be incorrect
attacks.method: Rebuild the H093 dual slack with multiplier 8 on clause edges and 0 on cross-clause complement edges, then verify exact LDL positivity.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the certified graphs may not be the graphs whose alpha labels are tested
attacks.method: Pass both generated certificates through the existing H096 collision-bundle verifier, which recomputes alpha from the embedded graph.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the exact H093 normalization might fail to add on disjoint union
attacks.method: Use block-diagonal primal solutions for the lower bound and concatenate dual clause-block certificates for the upper bound; full prose proof is committed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: reused variables could connect components
attacks.method: Require deterministic variable offsets for every copy before building conflict graphs.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: conjunction or disjoint union may change the intended SAT/UNSAT labels
attacks.method: A conjunction of satisfiable disjoint copies is satisfiable and one unsatisfiable component makes every UNSAT-side conjunction unsatisfiable.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the amplified family might not be polynomial-time constructible
attacks.method: Each member is r renamed copies of two constant seeds and has size linear in r.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a rich potential language may encode the whole computation history
attacks.method: Demand a fixed local syntax and polynomial-bit evaluation; the exact admissible language is not yet fixed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: local rewrites may not destroy global expansion without large interfaces
attacks.method: Target expander Tseitin and lifted random-CNF families; no preservation theorem for the new potential class is yet proved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: strict decrease may still allow exponentially many values
attacks.method: Require a polynomially bounded integer range or inverse-polynomial decrement; the current statement only promises polynomial-bit values.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: recovery metadata may store a hidden global answer
attacks.method: Charge every trace bit and forbid answer-dependent annotations outside local rule certificates.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Gaussian elimination may solve the entire core
attacks.method: Require the nonlinear gadget to retain hardness after all affine consequences are substituted.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a large restriction may delete every nonlinear gadget
attacks.method: Strengthen the generator obligation to every restriction above the live-variable threshold; no construction currently meets it.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: theta rank and separator width may not remain high on the same residual
attacks.method: Search for a transfer theorem between pseudoexpectation degree and residual separator width; this is an open barrier.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: random hard instances do not give a deterministic generator
attacks.method: Require polynomial-time deterministic construction; no candidate is registered yet.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the typed language may be exactly decomposable deterministic NNF
attacks.method: AND support disjointness and deterministic OR nodes strongly suggest a direct DNNF translation followed by the H016 lower-bound contradiction.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: auxiliary-variable forgetting may preserve only DNNF, losing determinism but not the lower bound
attacks.method: Apply the exact H016 projection closure argument; a complete syntactic translation remains to be written.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: support sets could themselves require superpolynomial storage
attacks.method: Charge explicit bitsets or canonical intervals; the statement counts this storage.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: explicit hard CNFs may force a node with large original-variable support
attacks.method: Target known DNNF-hard CNF families; a direct theorem would destroy H102.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the local transduction may preserve the exact level-one collision
attacks.method: Use all disjoint-union amplifications of H098 as mandatory fixtures for every candidate gadget map.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: bounded-radius gadgets may transport the source moment witness
attacks.method: Reduce the obstruction to H088-style local pseudoexpectation transport; the general theorem is open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a hidden global canonicalization could reintroduce solve-and-encode
attacks.method: Require a one-pass finite transduction with no data-dependent iteration or semantic branching.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a numerical gap may lack polynomial-bit exact certificates
attacks.method: Retain H097 conditioning and rational reconstruction as an independent required gate.
